# East Asian Drama

> > A comprehensive guide to Korean, Chinese, and Thai dramas featuring reviews, recommendations, and beginner guides for historical fantasy, romantic comedies, and time-travel series.

East Asian Drama is a personal review site run by Artemide, offering in-depth analysis and curated lists of Asian television dramas. The site specializes in Korean and Chinese dramas, with particular focus on historical fantasy, time-travel narratives, and romance genres including popular titles like Goblin, Ashes of Love, and The Secret of the Three Kingdoms.

## Key Topics

- Korean Drama (K-Drama)
- Chinese Drama (C-Drama)
- Time-Travel Dramas
- Historical Fantasy
- Romantic Comedy
- Body-Swap Narratives
- Goryeo Period
- Han Dynasty
- Three Kingdoms Era
- Gender Bender Dramas
- Contract Marriage Tropes
- Beginner Recommendations
- Drama Reviews
- Xianxia Genre

## Beginner Guides & Recommendations

- [Best 10 Korean Dramas for Beginners](https://eastasiandrama.com/top-10-korean-dramas-for-beginners): Beginner's guide to top 10 K-dramas including Secret Garden and DOTS
- [Chinese Dramas for Beginners. My Top 5 List](https://eastasiandrama.com/top-5-chinese-dramas-for-beginners): Top 5 fantasy historical Chinese dramas for new viewers
- [Differences Between Korean and Chinese Dramas](https://eastasiandrama.com/differences-between-korean-and-chinese-dramas): Comparison analysis of Korean vs Chinese drama production and culture
- [Underrated Korean Dramas with Huge International Success](https://eastasiandrama.com/underrated-korean-dramas-with-huge-international-success): List of underrated K-dramas like Healer with strong international fanbase

## Featured Drama Reviews

- [Goblin: The Great and Lonely God. Review](https://eastasiandrama.com/goblin-plot-and-review): Review of fantasy K-drama about 939-year-old immortal goblin Kim Shin
- [Ashes of Love. Heavy Sweetness Ash-Like Frost - Review](https://eastasiandrama.com/ashes-of-love-heavy-sweetness-ash-like-frost-review): Review of Chinese xianxia drama about immortal love story Jin Mi
- [The Secret of the Three Kingdoms. Plot and Review](https://eastasiandrama.com/the-secret-of-the-three-kingdoms-plot-and-review): Review of Chinese historical drama about Han Dynasty's last emperor
- [Faith (Korean Drama). Plot and Review](https://eastasiandrama.com/faith-2012-plot-and-review): Review of historical fantasy K-drama set in Goryeo period with Yuan
- [Bpoop Phaeh Saniwaat (Love Destiny). Review](https://eastasiandrama.com/bpoop-phaeh-saniwaat-love-destiny-review): Review of 2018 Thai time-travel romance set in 17th century Siam
- [Life on Mars (Korean Drama) - Review](https://eastasiandrama.com/life-on-mars-review): Review of Korean time-travel detective drama Life on Mars remake
